articles.title: Nvidia shares rise on earnings beat, raised outlook despite leadership uncertainty
articles.snippet: Speaking on the earnings call, Chairman Harvey Jones said the board has no intention of reinstating Jensen Huang as CEO.

articles.title: Tokenized Nvidia market cap surges 159% amid Jensen Huang’s exit
articles.snippet: Nvidia stock tokens reached $401.9 million in combined value as Jensen Huang stepped down and the chipmaker posted record quarterly revenue.

articles.title: Nvidia board rejects Huang comeback despite record $116B quarter
articles.snippet: Nvidia beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations by 5.6% and issued a stronger-than-expected sales forecast, while its board resisted growing calls for Jensen Huang’s reinstatement.

articles.title: Lucky Trader Banks 66,000% Profit on GTA 6 Meme Coin Ticker Confusion
articles.snippet: The trader turned $300 into over $200,000 as early footage of GTA 6 sent degens flocking between different token tickers.

articles.title: Morning Minute: Nvidia Beats, Board Says ‘No’ on Jensen
articles.snippet: Nvidia delivered its best earnings ever and raised forward guidance. And yet, the market mostly shrugged. What does it mean?
